程序包 com.sun.beans.finder

  • 类概要 
    类 说明
    BeanInfoFinder
    This is utility class that provides functionality to find a BeanInfo for a JavaBean specified by its type.
    ClassFinder
    This is utility class that provides static methods to find a class with the specified name using the specified class loader.
    ConstructorFinder
    This utility class provides static methods to find a public constructor with specified parameter types in specified class.
    FieldFinder
    This utility class provides static methods to find a public field with specified name in specified class.
    MethodFinder
    This utility class provides static methods to find a public method with specified name and parameter types in specified class.
    PersistenceDelegateFinder
    This is utility class that provides functionality to find a PersistenceDelegate for a JavaBean specified by its type.
    PrimitiveWrapperMap
    This utility class associates name of primitive type with appropriate wrapper.
    PropertyEditorFinder
    This is utility class that provides functionality to find a PropertyEditor for a JavaBean specified by its type.
